static_causal_trace.observation: The inherited full-metadata path emits APT candidates with discovery_source=APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN, binding_kind=apt, and executable ownership evidence.
Supplier routing already recognizes binding_kind=apt, so the top-level supplier router is not the first failing stage.
_merge_role_conditioned_apt() calls capability_discovery.search_apt_packages(), so the inherited producer is reached.
The consumer continues only when discovery_source equals APT_CATALOG; therefore candidates from APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN are dropped before apt_cli_probe or cli_contract_inference.
Existing routing coverage uses legacy APT_CATALOG examples and does not exercise the inherited APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN handoff.

causal_ordering.reason: The first failing interface occurs before CLI probing and contract inference, so contract-learning sufficiency cannot yet be measured on the inherited winner.

decision.repair_principle: Remove the obsolete source-label coupling and use the already-present generic apt binding identity for admission; preserve all existing zero-cost, secret, friction, version, archive-digest, probe, contract, verification and promotion gates.
decision.reason: The mismatch is directly proven from current canonical producer/consumer code; another diagnostic would only rediscover the same deterministic branch condition.
